simple.summary: פָּצַם (pâtsam) means to rend (by earthquake) First listed occurrence: Ps 60 4.

definitions.full: H6480. patsam [ מָּצַם ] verb split open (Arabic crack ; מַּצֵם ᵑ7 Jer 22:14 , cut out , make, window); — Qal Perfect 2masculine singular suffix of earth, מְּצַמְתָּ֑הּ Psa 60:4 (subject God).
